reading.scope: Current complete canonical 40–42 in reading order; continuity and final repair records read; no inference or rendering.

clarity.schemaValidation: Exact keys, every required field, types, enums and minima checked against schema; no additional keys.

wordLock.normalization: NFC, casefold, straight apostrophe; Unicode alphanumeric tokens retain internal apostrophes. SHA-256 of UTF-8 tokens joined by LF, no trailing LF. Independent category-scanning implementation also matches.
